reviews.text: We had such a wonderful experience with Uptown Clippers! They did an absolutely fantastic job with our puppy’s very first grooming and were so gentle, patient, and caring throughout the appointment. Our puppy looked adorable and so fresh afterward! We couldn’t be happier and will definitely be using them again.
By far the best grooming Rufus has had! I didn’t even know he could look this amazing! It’s a plus how very nice they are as well!

I got my first puppy this past December and have been looking for a groomer that we both want to stay with. Uptown Clippers make it easy to text/book an appointment, listen to how you want them to look, and are very timely as well. I have a bernedoodle and he seemed to enjoy it!

They did such a great job with my mini dachshund!! He looks so fluffy and clean and smells amazing. Great prices for the service you are getting. I will be using them again in the future! Before & after pics below!
They took such great care of my Nova girl and made her look beautiful! Even sent a couple videos during the process. Definitely recommend!
Great people who do a great job. My dog used to hate going to the groomer, but she is so relieved & calm when they pull out front of our home. You can tell they really care.
My dog looked like she really enjoyed the experience. The grooming team was patient and took care while grooming. I would definitely come back.

My sweet exotic short hair cat Ziggy had a great experience at Uptown Clippers! They are knowledgeable, friendly, and do a great job for a great price. 10/10 would recommend your fur baby getting groomed here!
We love Uptown Clippers! 10/10

Uptown Clippers did an amazing groom on my Doddle who was matted.  I honestly thought she would be getting a serious haircut.  Instead they returned Lucy combed out, clean and beautiful.  Lucy was happy then returned.  I was pleasantly surprise.  I highly recommend them! Their are many groomer to choose from... but one thing to keep in mind is not only the job done but more importantly, how your pet was treated when the door closes.  I must say they are kind, efficient and definitely go over and beyond.
Great service. They send update photos as they are in the van. Friendly service and a great haircut for my puppy's first ever grooming. The photo here is what they sent when they were done.

We used Uptown Clippers at the recommendation of a family member today for our corgi. He is notoriously difficult during grooming, and hasn’t been able to have his nails clipped for years. Somehow Uptown Clippers not only gave him a great bath/clip/de shedding, but also CLIPPED HIS NAILS!  And did so while keeping him calm and happy - they even sent videos!  We are so happy to have found Uptown Clippers, and will be using them for every groom in the future. They are professional, courteous, and most importantly do a great job!

If I could give 10 stars I would. We rescued a poodle who was severely matted and instead of shaving her down like most groomers would, they took the time to get all her knots out. They were so gentle with the whole process, sent me updates along the way ensuring my dog was in good hands. I honestly cannot say enough good things about these 2. I will be a lifelong customer.

Omg the best groomers i have encountered since i have been in Texas. Thanks for your warm welcoming and soft touch with my dog. I highly recommend this groomer. We have founder our Foreva Grooming Home ❤️
UPTOWN CLIPPERS ARE GREAT ….. THANK YOU GUYS SO MUCH , KASH IS SO EXCITED AND HAPPY ABOUT HIS GROOMING HE LOVES IT 🤩😊 10/10 WE WILL BE BACK ‼️🐾 …

I am beyond happy at how good they were with my baby. She was so matted and expected them
to have to shave her fully. They took extra care to make sure they didn’t have to.  This is the best hair cut she has ever gotten.  They really did such an amazing job, I will never go back to regular groomers. I always hated that my baby stayed all day at the groomers. This way, they come to you and about two hours later they were done. So professional and amazing. I would recommend them to everyone
I love my pet groomers!!! They are very sweet and my dogs love them so much!!! They do an amazing job. I will continue to use them. I couldn’t be happier :)

Uptown Clippers was so easy to schedule and they did an amazing job with our dog Archie. He can be a little finicky and they were very reassuring that he would be well taken care of. They sent photos and videos as they worked to keep us updated on how it was going and Archie came out looking so handsome and happy!
The friendliest staff and do such a great job! My Bernese mountain Dog always comes back happy and clean. The staff is so sweet and does a great job trimming up my boy.

If you are looking for a nice, professional dog groomer please use Uptown Clippers!!!! My dog had a great time and they are so nice and friendly. When I want my dog groomed again they will be who I use over and over again. 10/10 recommend and they also send videos throughout the whole process!!!! The cut looked 10x better than the picture I showed them. Thank you again!!!!!
They did an amazing job! Super easy appointment setting, great communication, great rates and great groom! Definitely recommend them!

Our little puppy is such a scaredy-cat- cries at everything- but she is always calm and happy when she gets her nails trimmed with Uptown Clippers! Walks out tail wagging every time, and that’s all that matters to me!

Minnie and Sadyd, the dynamic duo behind Uptown Clippers, did an amazing job grooming my 70-pound labradoodle, Buc-ee. They arrived right on time at 7:00 AM and finished up before I had to leave for work. I was thrilled with the results and can't wait to schedule another appointment with them. I highly recommend reaching out to this fantastic team!

Absolute angels! I cannot recommend this grooming service enough. They treated my foster dog with such kindness and care and addressed a medical issue he was having. After his grooming session he was glowing and I could tell that he was so …
Amazing services! Very convenient and my dog looked amazing. They come right to you, the extend the service and they are super nice!

This is the very best grooming my 14 year old retriever has ever had !! I highly recommend their gentleness and performance… my dog looks beautiful ! They even sent me videos at each stage of bathing and hair cutting …. They are the best !

Omg AMAZING! If you’re looking for great service and excellent grooming look no further. They took such good care of Mae and she didn’t want to leave when they were done. Can’t recommend them enough!!

They did SUCH a good job with my dog, Charlie! He’s typically nervous in grooming sessions but he was so comfortable with them. And he looked SO good afterwards, they definitely know what they’re doing!
